messages:
Priya: FYI customer 'Polaris' wants to pull private pilot forward by 8 days. Requirement: customer-managed keys (HSM) + p95 < 330ms. Need quick dep triage.
Jason: What's QPS and model? Need numbers to size GPU slots and prewarm.
Priya: Peak ~95 QPS, avg 28. Model preferred = 13B, customer OK with 7B as fallback.
Elena: Runtime: 7B with continuous batching + KV cache should hit p95. 13B needs pinned nodes or more slots. Also need routing fallback in case HSM pool isn't ready.
Ravi: Infra: HSM onboarding + VPC peering is ~9 business days. Hosted-KMS fallback pool can be ready in ~3 business days once model/slots locked.
Priya: So options: (A) Wait for HSM (delay); (B) Hosted-KMS fallback + 7B (fastest); (C) Hosted-KMS + 13B with bigger reservation. Thoughts?
Elena: Fastest = B. I'll prototype a route-with-fallback and a canary guard (p95 threshold) in 48h. Pseudocode: if pool.hsm_ready -> pool-hsm else -> pool-hosted-kms.
Jason: I'll estimate slot delta 13B vs 7B and prewarm mem budget by EOD.
Priya: Action items: Elena -> routing prototype + canary guard (48h). Ravi -> slot delta + earliest reserve date (tomorrow). Jason -> cost/prewarm numbers (EOD). Sec-bot: create ticket and schedule 30m sync.
sec-bot: Created ticket RDW-7777 "Polaris private pilot: HSM gating" and scheduled meeting 1791365400 (3pm PT). Assigned: Priya, Jason, Elena, Ravi.
Priya: If HSM slips we default to hosted-KMS + 7B and notify Polaris with risk statement + cutover plan. Will update SOW now. :thumbsup:
